# HyperFrames blocks (vendored, converted)

136 of 210 upstream blocks (HyperFrames v0.9.19, Apache-2.0) pass `node tools/blocks.mjs verify`. Install one with `reelwright add <project> <name>`, mount it with `KIT.mount('<name>', { start, dur, vars })`. Renderer: hyperframes only (pvk films are refused). The rest, with reasons: [UNSUPPORTED.md](UNSUPPORTED.md).
